name: run-cases
description: Execute approved test cases against a deployed DEV or staging environment, through the browser or an app on an Android device: refuse production and the local stack, recon the accounts and data, triage every case as automatable, semi-automatable, manual, or blocked, naming who clears each obstacle, agree the scope with the person before any case runs, run in at most three rounds, and write only the results it observed into a run record the QA lead approves and `atk:qa --bug` reads. Use when a cases file is approved, a non-production environment is deployed, and the team wants an agent to execute the automatable part instead of a tester. Triggers on: "run the test cases", "execute test cases", "run these cases on staging", "automate these test cases on DEV", "run test cases on the mobile app", "/atk:run-cases".

findings.excerpt: /atk:run-cases <cases-path>               # Triage, agree the scope, run, and record
